name: Live Template Results
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Keeps a manual disable when a note is renamed.
Retries a waiting property refresh on the next save.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
If you turn template results off for a note, renaming that note keeps them off.
A refresh after a watched property change (Pro) that had to wait now runs after the next save.
tip: Click a result, or move the cursor into it, to see and edit its Templater command.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Live Template Results is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for keeping it in your editor.

related.name: DOT Diagrams
related.blurb: Show Graphviz DOT code as a diagram in your theme colors.

related.name: Shortcuts Bridge
related.blurb: Runs an Apple Shortcut from a note or a command and passes text to it. Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

related.name: Local JSON Queries
related.blurb: Run local JSON queries on vault files and show the results as tables or text.
